recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If Vocabulary wants a stronger default rule, a display-case-sensitivity declaration mechanism, or explicit text that CodeSystem.caseSensitive does not control displays, handle that through a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5802 asked whether display text case on validation should be case-sensitive or case-insensitive. The Published/Persuasive Vocabulary resolution was to clarify that this is code-system dependent and clarify known described code systems where known.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5802. Jira records SVN revision 5692, historical release artifacts from release2 onward contain the accepted wording, and the current git-era OperationDefinition XML imported that wording during source/build rework.
additional_context: ValueSet, CodeSystem, and OperationDefinition are active current-build resources and their operation lists reference the validate-code OperationDefinitions. Later related final issues already cover adjacent display-validation behavior: FHIR-17218 for invalid-display/language caveats, FHIR-40770 for displayLanguage matching, and FHIR-41229 for lenient-display-validation. Zulip discussions in 2018, 2024, and 2026 show continuing implementation nuance and clarify that CodeSystem.caseSensitive is about codes, not displays, but no final later Jira decision found here supersedes the FHIR-5802 rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already includes the accepted FHIR-5802 clarification in both ValueSet and CodeSystem $validate-code display parameters, and changing the rule based only on unresolved community discussion would exceed this issue.
